text: The user asked to replace absolute paths in `.yolo-twice/` with portable markers (`$PROJECT`, `~`, `<user>`) for team portability, privacy and fewer tokens, and to check whether `claude --resume` still works with expanded paths. The assistant measured about 560 hits in the 2.1 MB folder (296 project root, 120 `-~-` slugs, 78 bare usernames, 65 home paths), confirmed from the CLI docs that `--resume` reuses the session id unless `--fork-session` is passed, and got the user's choices for the project root and username. It then wrote a plan (`code/packages/core/src/anonymize.ts`, redaction in `ingest.ts`, normalizer version 3, and a resume that expands paths into `cache/resume/` and forks), which the user approved, but no code has changed yet and the token savings are only about 0.5%.
